models.name: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
models.description: Generic [Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct) artifact for deployment with [LiteRT-LM](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/blob/main/kotlin/README.md). Compatible with GPU and CPU only — this artifact is not NPU-compatible.

models.name: Gemma3-1B-IT
models.description: Generic [Gemma3-1B-IT](https://huggingface.co/litert-community/Gemma3-1B-IT) artifact for deployment with [LiteRT-LM](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/blob/main/kotlin/README.md). Compatible with GPU and CPU only — this artifact is not NPU-compatible.

models.name: Gemma3-1B-IT-MT6991-NPU
models.description: [Gemma3-1B-IT](https://huggingface.co/litert-community/Gemma3-1B-IT) artifact pre-compiled for the **MediaTek MT6991** NPU. This is a distinct artifact from the generic Gemma3-1B-IT build and is compatible with the NPU backend only.

models.name: Gemma3-270M-IT-SM8850-NPU
models.description: [Gemma3-270M-IT](https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-3-270m-it) artifact for the **Qualcomm SM8850** (Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5) Hexagon NPU (HTP V81). SRQ bundle compiled on-device at load time (JIT): the first NPU run recompiles the model (~16 s), later runs in the same session are fast. Text-only.
